name.es: Comisión de la Ciudad de Opa-locka

coverage.en: This list starts from the actions, not the donors: every action the Opa-locka City Commission took from August 18, 2021 to October 14, 2026 that benefits a named company, developer, group or person (contracts and purchases, zoning and land use, leases, grants, settlements and permits), read from the records of 164 meetings. Votes come from the minutes and signed resolutions. Each action's parties, and any lobbyist named for it, were then checked against the donors of members on the ballot. The May 27, 2026 meeting has no minutes posted, and the October 14, 2026 minutes are a draft. The record does not name the applicants for site plans and rezonings. Before 2025, no minutes are posted for the regular meetings of November 22 and December 27, 2023, June 12, October 9, November 27 and December 25, 2024, or the special meetings of September 20 and November 29, 2023. Commissioner Bass's 2018 and 2020 donor reports are not online, so her gifts start with her 2022 campaign.
coverage.es: Esta lista parte de los actos, no de los donantes: cada acto de la Comisión de la Ciudad de Opa-locka entre el 18 de agosto de 2021 y el 14 de octubre de 2026 que beneficia a una empresa, desarrollador, grupo o persona con nombre (contratos y compras, zonificación y uso del suelo, arrendamientos, subvenciones, acuerdos y permisos), según los registros de 164 reuniones. Los votos vienen de las actas y las resoluciones firmadas. Luego se compararon las partes de cada acto, y cualquier cabildero nombrado para él, con los donantes de los miembros en la boleta. La reunión del 27 de mayo de 2026 no tiene acta publicada, y el acta del 14 de octubre de 2026 es un borrador. El registro no nombra a los solicitantes de planes del sitio y rezonificaciones. Antes de 2025, no hay actas publicadas de las reuniones ordinarias del 22 de noviembre y 27 de diciembre de 2023, ni del 12 de junio, 9 de octubre, 27 de noviembre y 25 de diciembre de 2024, ni de las reuniones especiales del 20 de septiembre y 29 de noviembre de 2023. Los informes de donantes de 2018 y 2020 de la comisionada Bass no están en línea, así que sus donaciones empiezan con su campaña de 2022.
coverage.ht: Lis sa a kòmanse ak aksyon yo, pa ak donatè yo: chak aksyon Komisyon Vil Opa-locka te pran ant 18 out 2021 ak 14 oktòb 2026 ki benefisye yon konpayi, pwomotè, gwoup oswa moun ki gen non (kontra ak acha, zonaj ak itilizasyon tè, lokasyon, sibvansyon, akò ak pèmi), selon dosye 164 reyinyon. Vòt yo soti nan pwosè-vèbal yo ak rezolisyon ki siyen yo. Apre sa, nou konpare pati chak aksyon, ak nenpòt lobiyis yo nonmen pou li, ak donatè manm ki sou bilten an. Reyinyon 27 me 2026 la pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye, epi pwosè-vèbal 14 oktòb 2026 la se yon bouyon. Dosye a pa nonmen moun ki fè demann pou plan sit ak nouvo zonaj. Anvan 2025, pa gen pwosè-vèbal pibliye pou reyinyon regilye 22 novanm ak 27 desanm 2023, 12 jen, 9 oktòb, 27 novanm ak 25 desanm 2024, ni pou reyinyon espesyal 20 septanm ak 29 novanm 2023. Rapò donatè 2018 ak 2020 komisyonè Bass yo pa sou entènèt, kidonk don li yo kòmanse ak kanpay 2022 li a.

Votes come from the clerk's action summary minutes, which list each member's vote. Consent items carry the single consent-agenda roll; pulled items carry their own vote. Where a member is missing from a roll (late arrival, virtual attendance) the vote is "unknown".

Applicants for most site plans, plats, variances, special exceptions and development agreements are not named in the minutes or titles; these carry "Owner of <address> (not named in minutes)" with the owner of record in owners.json.
Older minutes (2021-2022) are scanned PDFs with an OCR text layer; dollar amounts in some titles are garbled and were left out where unreadable.

Excluded under the standard: RFP issuances naming no vendor, budget amendments, code and land development regulation text amendments, interlocal agreements and state/county grants, scholarships, appointments, employment of charter officers, city-hosted events.
